Found: current clone accepts object-hash and says it must match the remote; default comes from config. Init docs say an existing repo's object hash cannot currently be changed and not every forge supports SHA-256. Native 0.45.1 changelog fixes signatures on SHA-256 repositories being stored under gpgsig-sha256 so Git recognizes them and jj reads them back. Thus local binary presence and generic signed-commit support do not establish correct interchange for every object format.

Investigate: full-length IDs independent of hardcoded SHA-1 width, signed SHA-256 roundtrip, supported forge profile, exact0.44 eligibility and restore without resigning/rebinding credentials. Deferred primary patch and runtime verification.
Follow-up: init.rs source S00319 directly confirms object-hash contract and rejects --at-op, --ignore-working-copy and --no-integrate-operation for init. Signature fix patch still deferred.

- Native SHA-256 signature fix patch and forge compatibility, exact0.44 operation-merge-depth fix presence, some client issue fix releases, actual large-repo pagination/performance and accessibility remain deferred. Public evidence gathered here is a lead set, not exhaustive product coverage.
